name: clean_rename_helper
title: Rename fmt_money to format_money
body: Naming cleanup; no behaviour change. Every caller is updated (two of them).
diff:
### billing/money.py (modified, +1/-1)
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-def fmt_money(cents: int, currency: str = "USD") -> str:
+def format_money(cents: int, currency: str = "USD") -> str:
     sign = "-" if cents < 0 else ""
     cents = abs(cents)
     return f"{sign}{currency} {cents // 100}.{cents % 100:02d}"

### billing/invoice.py (modified, +2/-2)
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
-from .money import fmt_money
+from .money import format_money
 
 
 def invoice_line(name: str, cents: int) -> str:
-    return f"{name:<30}{fmt_money(cents):>14}"
+    return f"{name:<30}{format_money(cents):>14}"

### billing/receipt.py (modified, +2/-2)
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
-from .money import fmt_money
+from .money import format_money
 
 
 def receipt_total(cents: int, currency: str) -> str:
-    return "Total: " + fmt_money(cents, currency)
+    return "Total: " + format_money(cents, currency)

files.billing/money.py:
def format_money(cents: int, currency: str = "USD") -> str:
    sign = "-" if cents < 0 else ""
    cents = abs(cents)
    return f"{sign}{currency} {cents // 100}.{cents % 100:02d}"
